page: Microsoft Azure E4nds_v6 is an Endv6-family virtual machine configured with 4 dedicated vCPUs on an x86_64 Intel processor architecture. Running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, this instance provides 32.0 GB of system memory, establishing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

The instance features 236 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and is designated as Premium Storage capable. As a network-optimized server type, it is engineered to handle workloads requiring fast local disk access and high network throughput, though it does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and local NVMe storage, this server is positioned for memory-intensive workloads, database hosting, and caching layers. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities, making it a resource-dense option for environments requiring predictable performance without the overhead of GPU acceleration.
